meta_description:
926 likes, 43 comments - ramit on October 19, 2026: "Our parents were handed a simple formula: get a good job, stay loyal, work hard, and you’ll be taken care of.

That formula isn’t working anymore. Costs keep rising, jobs feel less secure, and doing everything “right” can still leave you feeling squeezed.

And yet most of us were taught to just accept it. “You’re lucky to have a job.” “That’s just how it is.”

It doesn’t have to be. You need a different set of rules, and one of the most powerful is having more than one way to earn money.

The hardest part for most people is figuring out what they could actually sell. 

Comment CHALLENGE and I’ll send you my free challenge to find your idea. You’ll also save your seat for my live session tonight, Monday, Oct 19 at 8pm ET.".
